args.message:
Upgrade fastjson to 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337

CVE-2026-31337 (high): unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested
arrays, affecting fastjson <2.9.4. Pin to 2.9.4, the fixed version in
the 2.x line, to avoid unrelated behavior changes from a major upgrade.

args.body:
## Summary
Upgrades `fastjson` from 2.8.0 to 2.9.4 to remediate CVE-2026-31337 (high severity: unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays, affecting fastjson <2.9.4).

## Details
- Pinned to 2.9.4 (the fixed version in the 2.x line) rather than 3.1.0 to avoid unrelated behavior changes from a major version upgrade.
- Only change is `requirements.txt`; no code changes required.

## Validation
- CI run `ci-0001` on commit `c8b8ab7878`: **passed**.

cc @alex for review (code-owner approval required to merge).
args.head: fix/fastjson-cve-2026-31337

Note: merging into main requires code-owner approval, so the PR is awaiting alex's review — I have not merged it.
